cues: This is Conuco, a free field assistant for small farmers in the Dominican Republic.
Pests and diseases can destroy up to forty percent of a harvest, and in the hills there's often no signal and no agronomist.
Conuco reads a sick leaf with Gemini Nano on the phone, turns the weather into daily decisions, and keeps working offline.
Rosa's phone buzzes.
Every few hours, even offline, Conuco checks the forecast and her neighbours' reports,
and sends alerts: Black Sigatoka nearby, high fungus risk, and the next safe spray window.
Today turns it into one decision: not now, spray Saturday morning.
Water today, and watch for fungus.
In the field, she checks a sick banana leaf.
This phone has no Gemini Nano, so Conuco asks before the photo leaves.
Seconds later: Black Sigatoka, severe, with safe steps and no pesticide doses.
On a laptop with Gemini Nano, Chrome runs the same diagnosis right on the device.
Black Sigatoka again, with an honest confidence, and the photo never left.
One tap adds a step to her tasks.
One tap warns her neighbours on the outbreak map, as an eleven-kilometre area, never her farm.
At the market, she checks what buyers pay this week, and who pays best.
At noon, she asks Conuco a question, by voice or by text.
In the evening, she logs the day by voice.
Her farm log shows the month's profit, and how close each plot is to harvest.
Alerts, language and on-device AI are all in settings.
Under the hood, Conuco is built on Firebase.
Firebase AI Logic routes every request: Gemini Nano on the device first, Gemini in the cloud only with consent.
Remote Config tunes the thresholds live.
Authentication and Firestore keep each farm log private and offline-first.
App Check verifies every AI call, and Crashlytics and Performance watch every release.
Conuco. The device first, the cloud only with consent.
Built for the farmers where the signal stops.
Try it at petiht.com/conuco.
